results.name: shop/worker

error.Text: Deployment shop/worker has 1 replicas but 0 are available with status running

results.details:
Error: The deployment "worker" in namespace "shop" expects 1 pod to run, but none are currently running.

Solution: 
1. Check pod status: kubectl get pods -n shop
2. View pod logs: kubectl logs -n shop [pod-name]
3. Check events: kubectl describe pod -n shop [pod-name]
4. Fix issues found (image, resources, etc.)

error.Text: the termination reason is OOMKilled exitCode=137 container=worker pod=worker-86f68b9bf6-jrh5f

results.details:
Error: Your container ran out of memory (OOM) and was killed by Kubernetes.

Solution:
1. Increase memory limits in your deployment YAML
2. Add: resources.limits.memory (e.g., "512Mi" or "1Gi")
3. Apply changes: kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml
4. Monitor: kubectl top pod

results.name: shop/frontend

error.Text: Service has no endpoints, expected label app=frontend
Service has no endpoints, expected label tier=web

results.details:
Error: The Service cannot find any Pods because no Pods have the required labels (app=frontend AND tier=web).

Solution:
1. Check Pod labels: kubectl get pods --show-labels
2. Add missing labels to Pods: kubectl label pods <pod-name> app=frontend tier=web
3. Verify: kubectl get endpoints
